messages.text:
"Create a playable 2D side-scrolling physics puzzle platformer with colorful 16-bit pixel art inspired by classic SNES games.

Game concept:

The player controls a small adventurous character exploring an abandoned mechanical factory.

Movement and controls:

- Walk left and right.
- Jump onto platforms.
- Pick up nearby objects, carry them, and throw them.
- Use touchscreen controls suitable for a mobile phone.

Physics mechanics:

- Objects have weight, gravity, momentum, and collisions.
- Include a working seesaw that tilts when objects land on it.
- A heavy boulder can be dropped onto one end of the seesaw to launch a smaller object from the other end.
- Include a pressure plate that opens a locked gate when enough weight is placed on it.

Level design:

Create one complete, playable level with a starting point, several platforms, a seesaw, movable objects, a locked gate, and a clearly marked exit.

The player must solve at least two physics puzzles to reach the exit.

Important requirements:

- All platforms and objects must have working collision detection.
- The puzzles must be physically solvable.
- The character must be able to pick objects up and release them.
- Include a restart button.
- The level must have a functioning win condition.
- Use consistent physics rather than scripted puzzle animations.

Prioritize working gameplay over fancy graphics. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
